title: Hard Constraint Projection in a Physics Informed Neural Network (Burgers)
abstract: arXiv:2610.42106v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Physics informed machine learning provides a framework to study and simulate fluid dynamics, potentially at a fraction of the computational cost of traditional numerical methods, with the goal of improving the explainability, accuracy and robustness of purely data driven machine learning methods. In this work, we extend the hard constraint projection (HCP) method developed by Chen et al. [Journal of Computational Physics, 445, 110624, 2021] from a linear partial differential equation (PDE) to a nonlinear PDE: the 1D Burgers' equation. To strictly impose a discrete approximation of the governing equation, the Burgers' equation is first locally discretised (using a finite difference stencil) then decomposed into a constraint matrix and a prediction matrix. Using tools from linear algebra, the constraint matrix is used to construct a projection matrix. A physics informed neural network (PINN) [Raissi et al. Journal of Computational Physic

translated_title: 物理信息神经网络中的硬约束投影（伯格斯方程）
translated_abstract: 物理信息机器学习为研究和模拟流体动力学提供了一个框架，其计算成本可能仅为传统数值方法的一小部分，其目标是提升纯数据驱动机器学习方法可解释性、准确性和鲁棒性。在这项工作中，我们将Chen等人（Journal of Computational Physics, 445, 110624, 2021）提出的硬约束投影（HCP）方法从线性偏微分方程（PDE）扩展到非线性偏微分方程——一维伯格斯方程。为了严格施加控制方程的离散近似，首先对伯格斯方程进行局部离散化（使用有限差分模板），然后将其分解为约束矩阵和预测矩阵。利用线性代数工具，由约束矩阵构造出投影矩阵。物理信息神经网络（PINN）（Raissi等，Journal of Computational Physic...（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本文将硬约束投影（HCP）方法从线性偏微分方程首次扩展到非线性的一维伯格斯方程，通过有限差分离散化并将方程分解为约束矩阵和预测矩阵来构建投影矩阵，从而在物理信息神经网络中严格施加控制方程约束。
en_tdlr: This work extends the hard constraint projection (HCP) method from linear PDEs to the nonlinear 1D Burgers' equation, constructing a projection matrix via local finite-difference discretization and decomposition into constraint and prediction matrices, so as to strictly impose the governing equation within a physics informed neural network.
